content: Add an on-demand Vulkan runtime tool environment for M0130/W0131. Pin the Mesa Vulkan ICD and Vulkan validation-layer inputs in toolchain manifests, expose them through a separate .#vulkan-runtime shell, and keep the existing .#vulkan tool shell and project semantics unchanged. The runtime environment enables local smoke/probe execution but is not physical NVIDIA or dual-driver qualification evidence.

Keep Vulkan headers/loader/tools in the existing vulkan tool output and place Mesa ICD plus validation layers in a separate on-demand vulkan-runtime output. Do not force a software ICD through the default shell; callers choose VK_ICD_FILENAMES or the host ICD, while the shell adds the pinned runtime libraries and layer data to its search paths.

Added toolchains/vulkan-runtime-1.json and nix/toolchains/vulkan-runtime.nix, exposed packages.vulkan-runtime and devShells.vulkan-runtime, and documented the W0131 stage. Product revisions are 836c6e3 and 6c7c3ff; the existing .#vulkan tool-only profile remains unchanged.

Nix eval/flake show and runtime materialization passed; .#vulkan-runtime vulkaninfo loaded AMD RADV with API 1.4.354 and exposed Khronos validation. Capability, target-preflight, stream-graph focused tests passed 3/3, full Vulkan CTest passed 88/88, nixfmt/JSON/diff checks passed. This is host smoke/provisioning evidence only, not physical NVIDIA or dual-driver qualification.
